notes.title: All Whispering Tome - Demo Updated
notes.content:
Release update has been made to the demo. Please see it in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206270/All_Whispering_Tome__Demo][b][u]All Whispering Tome - Demo[/u][/b][/url] and send your feedbacks to us.

Changes
* Full keyboard navigation added.
* Added credits and help pages.
* Options screen updated
* Dialogs are made dismissible 
* Story passages updated

Bug fixes
* Theme music stops in Sub Screens. : Fixed
* Highligthing index is not confined to visible sheet. : Fixed

[i]So, take your time, immerse yourself in the flow of stories, and enjoy.[/i]
